A real number is a solution of an inequality involving a variable if a true statement is obtained when the variable is replaced by that number. The set of all real numbers satisfying the inequality is called the solution set. We often use interval notation to describe the solution set.

problem.paragraph: Find the set of real numbers that satisfy $$- 1 \leq 2x - 5 < 7$$ .

solution.paragraph: Add $$5$$ to each member of the given double inequality, obtaining
Next, multiply each member of the resulting double inequality by $$\frac{1}{2}$$ , yielding
Thus, the solution is the set of all values of $$x$$ lying in the interval $$\lbrack 2,6)$$ .

Observe that $$x^{2} + 2x - 8 = (x + 4)(x - 2)$$ , so the given inequality is equivalent to the inequality $$(x + 4)(x - 2) < 0$$ . Since the product of two real numbers is negative if and only if the two numbers have opposite signs, we solve the inequality $$(x + 4)(x - 2) < 0$$ by studying the signs of the two factors $$x + 4$$ and $$x - 2$$ . Now, $$x + 4 > 0$$ when $$x > - 4$$ , and $$x + 4 < 0$$ when $$x < - 4$$ . Similarly, $$x - 2 > 0$$ when $$x > 2$$ , and $$x - 2 < 0$$ when $$x < 2$$ . These results are summarized graphically in Figure 2.

Therefore, the required solution is the set of all $$x$$ in the intervals $$( - \infty, - 1\rbrack$$ and $$(1,\infty)$$ .

problem.paragraph: Solve the inequalities $$\left| x \middle| \leq 5 \right.$$ and $$\left| x \middle| \geq 5 \right.$$ .

solution.paragraph: First, we consider the inequality $$\left| x \middle| \leq 5 \right.$$ . If $$x \geq 0$$ , then $$\left| x \middle| = x \right.$$ , so $$\left| x \middle| \leq 5 \right.$$ implies $$x \leq 5$$ in this case. On the other hand, if $$x < 0$$ , then $$\left| x \middle| = - x \right.$$ , so $$\left| x \middle| \leq 5 \right.$$ implies $$- x \leq 5$$ or $$x \geq - 5$$ . Thus, $$\left| x \middle| \leq 5 \right.$$ means $$- 5 \leq x \leq 5$$ (Figure 5a). To obtain an alternative solution, observe that $$|x|$$ is the distance from the point $$x$$ to zero, so the inequality $$\left| x \middle| \leq 5 \right.$$ implies immediately that $$- 5 \leq x \leq 5$$ .
